summary: Iteration 8: tested the new overtime pending/approved validation workflow + configurable monthly threshold alert (backend + frontend). Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_overtime_status_iter8.py (30 tests) + full regression run of /app/backend/tests => 121/121 pass. Verified POST /api/overtime defaults status='pending'; PUT /overtime/{id}/validate -> approved + validated_at + validated_by (404 on unknown id, 401/403 without auth); PUT /reject -> back to pending with validated_at=null; POST /overtime/validate-tech bulk-validates only pending entries of that tech+month (returns correct 'validated' count, 400 without month, auth-guarded); admin edit of an approved entry preserves status='approved'; GET /api/overtime returns rows with approved_hours/pending_hours/total_hours/over_threshold and top-level threshold. Hardening confirmed: hours=99 -> 422, hours=-1 -> 422, date='2026-13-45' -> 400 'Date invalide', hours=8 flow unchanged, hours=0 still deletes, upsert still de-duplicates. Settings: GET returns overtime_alert_threshold (default 30), PUT persists 20 / 0 / 30 (admin only; unauthenticated 401/403); threshold=0 disables over_threshold for all rows. Frontend (/heures-sup, admin): typing 4h -> dashed amber cell + 'Xh à valider' in summary; per-cell hover check button (overtime-validate-<name>-<date>) validates the entry -> solid emerald cell + 'Xh validées'; mixed state shows '4h validées + 3h à valider' with 'Tout valider' link (overtime-validate-all-<name>) which bulk-approves and then disappears; rows are alphabetical (Evan, Guillaume, Ludo, Momo, Sébastien, Thanh) and no longer jump while typing. Threshold alert: with threshold=5 the red 'Seuil d'alerte atteint (5h/mois)' banner (overtime-alert) lists 'Sébastien (9h)', the summary card gets a red border + AlertTriangle and the row total renders red; threshold=0 removes banner + red styling. All test data cleaned (Sébastien 2026-08-10/11/12 deleted, overtime collection has 0 TEST_ docs) and overtime_alert_threshold restored to 30.

minor.issue: updates filter drops None but also cannot ever clear a field; also no bounds on overtime_alert_threshold (negative values accepted, e.g. -5, which silently disables the alert). Suggest Field(ge=0, le=500).
payload typed as raw dict instead of a Pydantic model (no validation/schema); month is only truncated to 7 chars, '9999-99' is accepted (returns validated:0).
technician_name still free text (not checked against team_members) and there is still no unique index on (technician_name,date) — carried over from iteration 7.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 NOT IMPLEMENTED: there is no 'Alerte heures supplémentaires' Card and no input data-testid='settings-overtime-threshold' (verified count=0 on the rendered page, and grep finds no 'threshold'/'overtime' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx). SettingsContext DEFAULTS also lacks overtime_alert_threshold, so the value is not exposed to the UI. The threshold can currently only be changed via a direct API call.

After typing hours (optimistic insert), the created entry has no id (optimisticUpdate pushes {technician_name,date,hours,status:'pending'} without the id returned by POST). The hover validate button is still rendered, and clicking it is a silent no-op (validateOne returns early on !entry?.id — no toast, no error). Reproduced: cell stayed dashed amber after the click; only works after a page reload.

Optimistic grand_total is wrong when a technician has both approved and pending hours: computeTotals does Object.values({...approved, ...pending}) so the pending amount OVERWRITES the approved amount per tech. Reproduced: 7h approved + 2h new pending showed 'Total mois : 2h' (row total correctly 9h); correct 9h only after reload.

integration_issues.issue: The 'Ajuster le seuil' link uses <a href='/parametres'> (full page reload instead of react-router Link) and lands on a Settings page that has no threshold field, so the CTA is a dead end.

issues: Day 31 column is still clipped/hidden behind the sticky right 'Total' column at 1920px (carried over from iteration 7, unfixed).
When threshold=0 (alert disabled) the header subtitle still reads 'Alerte au seuil de 30h' because of the `data.threshold || 30` fallback — misleading; should read 'désactivée'.
The per-cell validate button is a 16x16px target revealed only on hover (opacity-0 group-hover) — hard to hit and invisible on touch devices; consider always-visible or a row-level action.
HeuresSup.jsx: 2 react/no-unescaped-entities errors (lines 177, 196) and 1 unused eslint-disable directive (line 111).

action_items: IMPLEMENT the missing Settings UI: 'Alerte heures supplémentaires' Card + Input data-testid='settings-overtime-threshold' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx, include overtime_alert_threshold in the form state/save payload and in SettingsContext DEFAULTS (currently absent).
Fix optimisticUpdate to store the id returned by POST /api/overtime so the per-cell validate button works without a reload (or hide the button until the entry has an id).
Fix computeTotals grand_total: sum approved+pending per tech instead of spread-merging the two maps ({...approved, ...pending} loses approved hours).
Replace <a href='/parametres'> in the alert banner with react-router <Link> (avoid full reload) once the settings field exists.
Fix the day-31 column clipped by the sticky Total column (still open from iteration 7).
Show 'alerte désactivée' instead of '30h' in the subtitle when threshold=0; add server-side bounds on overtime_alert_threshold (ge=0) and type validate-tech payload with a Pydantic model.
critical_code_review_comments: HeuresSup.jsx computeTotals: `Object.values({ ...approved, ...pending })` is a data-loss bug — per-tech keys collide.
HeuresSup.jsx optimisticUpdate: the synthetic entry lacks `id`, so downstream actions (validate) silently fail; return the API response and merge it.
server.py validate-tech accepts an untyped dict payload — use a Pydantic model (technician_name, month) for validation and OpenAPI accuracy.
server.py is now 2145 lines — split into routers (auth/sales/projects/overtime/settings/payments) per the >700-line guideline.
GET /api/overtime still uses a $regex prefix scan on date with limit 5000 and no index; prefer $gte/$lt range + index.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_overtime_iter7.py (row-sort assertion updated for the new (over_threshold, -total, name) ordering)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Settings threshold UI: never added to Settings.jsx / SettingsContext DEFAULTS — the backend field exists and works, only the UI layer is missing. 2) Validate-after-typing no-op: optimisticUpdate builds a local entry object without the id from the POST response, and HoursCell.validateOne early-returns when entry.id is undefined, so the rendered check button does nothing until a reload re-fetches real ids. 3) Wrong 'Total mois' in optimistic state: computeTotals merges the approved and pending maps with object spread, so for a tech present in both maps the pending value replaces the approved value before summing. Backend GET /api/overtime returns the correct grand_total, hence the value self-heals after reload.
